stem.text: A student wanted to find out the rate of transpiration using a potometer as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a potometer with a cut shoot, a reservoir, an air bubble in a capillary tube, a volume scale, and a beaker of water, with printed labels for each part.

stem.text: The student was told to work out a value for transpiration using the units $\text{mm}^{3}$, $\text{m}^{-2}$ and $\text{hour}^{-1}$.
Which measurements would the student need to take?

A.text: volume of water in the reservoir, length of the capillary tubing, temperature and how many leaves are on the shoot

B.text: volume of water in the reservoir, radius of the capillary tubing, time and surface area of the leaves

C.text: distance air bubble moves, radius of the capillary tubing, time and surface area of the leaves

D.text: distance air bubble moves, length of the capillary tubing, temperature and how many leaves are on the shoot
